title: Amasiko
description: Ten short stories about Zulu culture: a grandmother's clay beer pots, a cleansing ritual after a year of bad luck, a church choir on Palm Sunday, a folk tale of a proud baboon, Zulu food on Heritage Day, the Zulu months on a farm, a young man's own hut, a coming-of-age celebration, a chief's judgement long ago, and a respectful date at the cinema.

lessons.title: Ukhamba lukagogo
lessons.summary: In Nkwalini, Zakithi learns pottery from her grandmother Nomalungelo: they fetch black clay from the river in a bucket, break off pieces and build a beer pot coil by coil, scratch little squares into it, and her first pot cracks in the fire; her second survives, is painted with red ochre and admired in town.
lessons.text:
UZakithi uneminyaka eyishumi. Ngamaholide uhlala nogogo wakhe, uNomalungelo, eNkwalini. Bonke abantu bayamazi uGogo, ngoba wenza izinkamba ezinhle. Ukhamba yimbiza yebumba. Abantu baphuza utshwala besiZulu okhambeni, futhi bagcina amanzi apholile ezinkambeni.

Ngolunye usuku uGogo uthi: "Zakithi, namuhla ngizokufundisa ukwenza ukhamba." Bathatha ibhakede elikhulu, bahambe baye emfuleni. Eduze komfula kukhona ibumba elimnyama. UZakithi ugcwalisa ibhakede ngebumba. Ibhakede lisinda kakhulu, kodwa uZakithi uyaliphatha aze afike ekhaya.

Ekhaya uGogo uthela amanzi ebumbeni, bese exuba ibumba namanzi ngezandla zakhe isikhathi eside. Bese uhlephula ingxenye yebumba, ayinike uZakithi. Bobabili bahlephula izingxenye ezincane ebumbeni, benze izintambo ezinde. UGogo ubeka izintambo enye phezu kwenye. Kancane kancane ukhamba luyakhula.

Kuyashisa. UZakithi usula ibunzi lakhe ngesandla esinebumba. Manje ibumba likhona nasebunzini lakhe. UGogo uyahleka, bese naye usula ibunzi lakhe.

Ngemuva kwamahora amabili kukhona izinkamba ezimbili eduze kwabo: olukhulu lukaGogo, nolunye oluncane lukaZakithi. UGogo uthatha ummese omncane. Udweba izikwele ezincane okhambeni lwakhe. Izikwele zakhe zilingana zonke. UZakithi naye udweba izikwele okhambeni lwakhe, kodwa izikwele zakhe azilingani. Izinkamba zoma emthunzini isonto lonke.

Ngemuva kwesonto uGogo wenza umlilo omkhulu ngaphandle. Ubeka izinkamba emlilweni. Ukhamba lukaGogo luqinile. Kodwa kuzwakala umsindo omncane, futhi ukhamba lukaZakithi lwaphuka. Lwaphuka lwaba izingxenye ezintathu.

UZakithi uyadabuka. UGogo uthi: "Ungadabuki, mzukulu wami. Izinkamba zami zokuqala nazo zaphuka. Ukhaliphile, futhi unezandla ezinhle. Uzofunda."

Ngemuva komlilo uGogo uthatha ubomvu. Ubomvu yinhlabathi ebomvu. Uxuba ubomvu namanzi, bese ependa ukhamba lwakhe. Manje ukhamba lubomvu futhi luhle kakhulu. UZakithi wenza olunye ukhamba. Lolu khamba alwaphuki emlilweni.

NgoMgqibelo bahamba baya edolobheni, bayothengisa izinkamba. Abantu abaningi bame eduze kwezinkamba zabo. Bazibuka ngokuncoma. Insizwa ithenga ukhamba oluncane. Ithi: "Lwenziwe ngubani lolu khamba?" UGogo uthi: "Lwenziwe ngumzukulu wami. Uyakhalipha lo mntwana." UZakithi uzwa ukuncoma kwabantu, futhi uyajabula kakhulu.

Imibuzo:
UGogo wenzani?
Wenza izinkamba ngebumba.
UZakithi ugcwalisa ibhakede ngani?
Uligcwalisa ngebumba, ibumba elimnyama elivela emfuleni.
Kwenzekani okhambeni lokuqala lukaZakithi?
Lwaphuka emlilweni lwaba izingxenye ezintathu.
UGogo upenda ukhamba lwakhe ngani?
Ulupenda ngobomvu, inhlabathi ebomvu.
Abantu basedolobheni bazibuka kanjani izinkamba?
Bazibuka ngokuncoma.

lessons.title: Ishwa likaKhanyiso
lessons.summary: Khanyiso of Mondlo has a year of bad luck: loose brakes send his car into the garage wall, old meat at a wedding makes him ill and he loses his job; his older brother Mluleki has him take an emetic at the river, the family slaughters a heifer, and with a new job he finally fits new brakes.
lessons.text:
Lo nyaka ubunzima kakhulu kuKhanyiso waseMondlo. Ngolunye usuku wayeshayela imoto yakhe ebuya emsebenzini. Ibhuleki lalixegile, futhi lapho efika ekhaya imoto yaqhubeka nokuhamba. Yashayisa udonga lwegalaji lakhe. UKhanyiso waphuma emotweni ephila kahle, kodwa imoto nodonga lwegalaji kwaphuka.

Ngakusasa wabiza indoda yasegalaji edolobheni. Indoda yathatha imoto yahamba nayo egalaji. Yathi: "Ibhuleki lakho belixegile kakhulu. Ungaphinde ushayele imoto enebhuleki elixegayo." UKhanyiso wakhokha imali eningi.

Ngesonto elilandelayo uKhanyiso waya emshadweni, wadla inyama endala. Inyama yamgulisa kakhulu. Walala embhedeni izinsuku ezintathu, futhi akayanga emsebenzini. Ngenxa yalokho walahlekelwa ngumsebenzi wakhe.

Ubhuti wakhe, uMluleki, weza ezombona. UMluleki mdala kunoKhanyiso, ngakho uKhanyiso umbiza ngokuthi "bhuti". UKhanyiso wathi: "Bhuti, lo nyaka nginamashwa amaningi. Imoto yaphuka, inyama yangigulisa, umsebenzi wami uhambile."

Ubhuti wakhe wathi: "Lokhu yishwa. Ogogo bethu bathi uma umuntu eneshwa elikhulu, kufanele aphalaze. Uphuza umuthi namanzi amaningi, bese uyaphalaza. Ngale ndlela ukhipha okubi emzimbeni wakho."

Ekuseni kakhulu uKhanyiso nobhuti wakhe baya emfuleni. UMluleki wanika uKhanyiso umuthi kagogo wabo. UKhanyiso waphuza umuthi namanzi amaningi, bese ephalaza. Kwakunzima, kodwa akayekanga. Waphalaza kanjalo izinsuku ezintathu.

NgoMgqibelo umndeni wabo wahlaba isithole. Isithole sasingesikhulu, kodwa sasinamafutha. Umalume wabo wema esibayeni, wakhuluma nabantu abadala bomndeni abangasekho. Wathi: "Khiphani ishwa kulo mntwana wenu." Bese bonke abantu bomndeni badla inyama yesithole ndawonye.

Ngemuva kwesonto uKhanyiso wathola umsebenzi omusha. Ngemali yakhe yokuqala washayela imoto yakhe waya egalaji futhi. Indoda yasegalaji yafaka ibhuleki elisha. Manje imoto iyema kahle, futhi ibhuleki alixegi.

UKhanyiso wathi kuMluleki: "Ngiyabonga, bhuti. Ishwa lihambile." UMluleki wahleka wathi: "Ishwa lihambile, kodwa nawe wenze okuthile. Walungisa ibhuleki!"

Imibuzo:
Kungani imoto kaKhanyiso yashayisa udonga lwegalaji?
Ngoba ibhuleki layo lalixegile, futhi imoto yaqhubeka nokuhamba.
Yini eyagulisa uKhanyiso?
Inyama endala ayidla emshadweni yamgulisa.
UMluleki ungubani?
UMluleki ngubhuti kaKhanyiso, mdala kunaye.
Uma umuntu eneshwa, ogogo bathi kufanele enzeni?
Bathi kufanele aphuze umuthi namanzi amaningi, bese ephalaza.
Umndeni wahlabani ngoMgqibelo?
Wahlaba isithole.

lessons.title: Ikhwaya yaseNchanga
lessons.summary: London-born Nonkosi visits her grandmother in Inchanga and joins the church choir; the choirmaster Ntombela spells and pronounces the hard words for her, her throat gets sore, and on Palm Sunday, after the minister's greeting and his sermon on kindness, she sings so well that the congregation is amazed.
lessons.text:
UNonkosi uneminyaka eyishumi nesithupha. Wazalelwa eLondon, futhi ukhuluma isiNgisi kahle, kodwa isiZulu sakhe asisihle kakhulu. NgoMashi uvakashela ugogo wakhe eNchanga amasonto amabili.

UGogo uhuba ekhwayeni yesonto. NgoLwesine uthatha uNonkosi baye ekhwayeni. Ikhwaya ihuba kamnandi kakhulu. Indoda ehola ikhwaya, uNtombela, uthi: "Nonkosi, ungathanda ukuhuba nathi ngeSonto?" UNonkosi uthi: "Ngiyathanda, kodwa angikwazi ukuphimisa amagama esiZulu kahle."

UNtombela uthi: "Ngizokusiza." Ubhala amagama engoma ephepheni. Uwapela kancane, igama ngalinye, futhi uNonkosi uyawabhala. Bese uyawaphimisa, uNonkosi aphinde emva kwakhe. Amagama ayisithupha anzima kakhulu kuye. UNtombela uwapela futhi, aphinde awaphimise kaningi.

UNonkosi ufunda amagama ekhaya izinsuku ezintathu. Uhuba ekuseni, uhuba kusihlwa. Ngolwesihlanu ebusuku umphimbo wakhe ubuhlungu. UGogo umenzela itiye elishisayo elinoshukela. Uthi: "Itiye elishisayo lisiza umphimbo. Namuhla ungahubi. Phumula."

NgeSonto, ngaphambi kwePhasika, abantu abaningi beza esontweni bephethe amaqabunga esundu. Isundu yisihlahla eside esikhula ezindaweni ezishisayo. Izingane zibeka amaqabunga esundu phansi ngaphambi kwendlu yesonto.

Umfundisi uqala ngesibingelelo. Uthi: "Ngiletha isibingelelo esivela ebandleni laseThekwini." Bese eshumayela ngobumnene. Intshumayelo yakhe imfushane, kodwa inhle. Uthi: "Ubumnene bungcono kunamandla. Umuntu onobumnene usiza abanye, futhi akathukutheli ngokushesha."

Ngemuva kwentshumayelo ikhwaya iyasukuma. UNonkosi umi phakathi kukaGogo noNtombela. Manje umphimbo wakhe uphilile. Uhuba ngezwi elihle, aphimise wonke amagama kahle. Ikhwaya ihuba kamnandi.

Abantu bayambuka uNonkosi ngokumangala. Owesifazane omdala uthi: "Le ntombazane ihlala eLondon, kodwa iphimisa isiZulu kahle kakhulu!" UGogo uyakubona ukumangala kwabo, futhi uyajabula.

Ngemuva kwesonto umfundisi ubonga uNonkosi ngobumnene. Uthi: "Uma ubuyela eLondon, sicela utshele ibandla lakho ukuthi sithumela isibingelelo sethu."

Imibuzo:
UNonkosi uvakashela ubani eNchanga?
Uvakashela ugogo wakhe.
UNtombela umsiza kanjani uNonkosi?
Ubhala amagama engoma, awapele, futhi awaphimise kancane.
Kungani uGogo enzela uNonkosi itiye?
UGogo umenzela itiye ngoba umphimbo wakhe ubuhlungu.
Abantu beza esontweni bephethe amaqabunga esundu na?
Yebo, beza bephethe amaqabunga esundu.
Intshumayelo yomfundisi ikhuluma ngani?
Intshumayelo yakhe ikhuluma ngobumnene.

lessons.title: Imfene ezigqajayo
lessons.summary: A folk tale: a proud baboon calls the monkey a fool; the leopard that roars on the hill sets a trap on the path to the deep pool, the baboon jumps it and dives in to show off, the crocodile drags it down until it nearly drowns, and the monkey pulls it out; the baboon stops boasting.
lessons.text:
Kudala, ehlathini elikhulu, kwakukhona isiziba esijulile. Esizibeni kwakuhlala ingwenya enkulu. Phezu kwentaba eseduze kwakuhlala ingwe. Ebusuku ingwe yayibhonga, futhi zonke izilwane zazesaba lapho zizwa ukubhonga kwayo.

Ezihlahleni eziseduze nesiziba kwakuhlala imfene nenkawu. Imfene yayizigqaja kakhulu. Yayithi: "Mina ngihlakaniphe kunazo zonke izilwane zehlathi." Yayithi enkawini: "Wena uyisilima. Awazi lutho." Inkawu yayingaphenduli. Yayithula nje. Inkawu yayincane, kodwa yayihlakaniphile. Yayibuka zonke izinto ehlathini, futhi yayilalela kahle lapho ezinye izilwane zikhuluma.

Ngolunye usuku ingwe yafuna ukudla imfene. Yagiba ugibe endleleni eya esizibeni, ngoba yayazi ukuthi imfene iphuza amanzi khona njalo ekuseni. Inkawu yayibona ingwe ibeka ugibe. Yagijima yaya emfeneni.

Inkawu yathi: "Ungahambi ngendlela eya esizibeni namuhla. Ingwe igibe ugibe lapho."

Imfene yahleka. Yathi: "Mina angiyisilima njengawe. Ngizolubona ugibe." Yayizigqaja kakhulu, ngakho ayizange ilalele.

Imfene yahamba ngaleyo ndlela. Yalubona ugibe, yaleqa. Yahleka kakhulu. Yathi: "Ubonile? Ngihlakaniphile!" Bese ifuna ukubonisa inkawu ukuthi inamandla amakhulu. Yathi: "Manje ngizocwila esizibeni, ngibhukude."

Inkawu yathi ngezwi elikhulu: "Cha! Ingwenya ihlala esizibeni!" Kodwa imfene yacwila emanzini.

Phakathi kwesiziba ingwenya yabamba umlenze wemfene. Yayidonsela phansi emanzini. Imfene yayingakwazi ukuphefumula. Yabona ukuthi izominza.

Inkawu yagijima yakhwela esihlahleni esiseduze. Yalenga phezu kwesiziba, yanika imfene isandla sayo. Imfene yasibamba isandla senkawu. Inkawu yayidonsa ngamandla. Ingwenya yayiyeka imfene, futhi imfene yaphuma emanzini. Ayizange iminze.

Imfene yahlala phansi, ikhathele kakhulu. Yathi enkawini: "Ngiyabonga. Bengiyisilima mina, hhayi wena. Ngeke ngiphinde ngizigqaje."

Kusukela ngalolo suku imfene yayilalela inkawu. Ebusuku ingwe yayisabhonga phezu kwentaba, kodwa imfene nenkawu zazihlala ndawonye ezihlahleni. Abantu abadala bayixoxa le ndaba ezinganeni. Bathi: "Umuntu ozigqajayo akabalaleli abanye, ngakho ufika enkingeni. Umuntu olalelayo uyaphila."

Imibuzo:
Yini eyayihlala esizibeni?
Kwakuhlala ingwenya enkulu esizibeni.
Imfene yayithini ngenkawu?
Yayithi inkawu iyisilima.
Ingwe yagiba ugibe kuphi?
Yagiba ugibe endleleni eya esizibeni.
Kungani imfene yacwila esizibeni?
Ngoba yayizigqaja, ifuna ukubonisa inkawu amandla ayo.
Ubani owasiza imfene ukuba ingaminzi?
Inkawu yayisiza, yayidonsa ngamandla.

lessons.title: Ukudla kwesiZulu eGoli
lessons.summary: On Heritage Day Skhumbuzo cooks Zulu food in Johannesburg for his workmates: amaranth from his neighbour, his grandmother's three-legged iron pot from the cupboard, beef fried and stewed on the stove, a pot of porridge that boils over while he talks on the phone, meat so soft it needs no chewing, and bananas with cream.
lessons.text:
USkhumbuzo usebenza ehhovisi eGoli. Abantu abasebenza naye bavela ezindaweni eziningi zezwe. NgoSeptemba, ngoSuku lwamaGugu, uSkhumbuzo uthi kubo: "NgeSonto ngizoniphekela ukudla kwesiZulu ekhaya." Abangane bakhe bayajabula. Abaningi babo abakwazi ukudla kwesiZulu.

NgoMgqibelo uSkhumbuzo uya ezitolo. Uthenga inyama yenkomo, impuphu, usawoti, ubhanana nokhilimu. Kodwa akayitholi imbuya ezitolo. Ushayela umama wakhe ocingweni. Umama uthi: "Imbuya ikhona engadini kamakhelwane wakho. Uyayitshala njalo." Umakhelwane omdala unika uSkhumbuzo imbuya eningi. Uthi: "Imbuya iyimifino emihle. Ogogo bethu bayidla njalo, futhi iyasiza umzimba."

NgeSonto ekuseni uSkhumbuzo uvula ikhabethe. Ngaphakathi kwekhabethe kukhona ibhodwe elidala likagogo wakhe. Ibhodwe lenziwe ngensimbi, futhi linemilenze emithathu. Ulikhipha ekhabetheni, aligeze kahle.

Okokuqala uSkhumbuzo uthosa inyama emafutheni ebhodweni. Uyithosa ize ibe nsundu. Bese ethela amanzi, ayeke inyama ipheke isikhathi eside esitofini.

Ngemuva kwalokho ugeza imbuya, ayisike. Uthosa imbuya kancane emafutheni nosawoti. Imbuya inuka kamnandi.

Bese ubeka ibhodwe lesibili esitofini, elinamanzi nempuphu. Ngalesi sikhathi ucingo lwakhe luyakhala. Ngumngane wakhe uNtsako. USkhumbuzo ukhuluma isikhathi eside. Uma ebuyela ekhishini, amanzi ebhodweni ayachichima. Isitofu sigcwele impuphu namanzi. USkhumbuzo usheshe akhiphe ibhodwe esitofini. Uyahleka, bese ehlanza isitofu. Akaphinde akhulume ocingweni ngenkathi epheka.

Emini abangane bakhe bayafika. USkhumbuzo ubaphekele inyama, imbuya nempuphu. Inyama ithambile kakhulu. Abangane bayayithanda imbuya, futhi bayabuza ukuthi iphekwa kanjani. USkhumbuzo uyabachazela. Abangane bahlafuna kancane, bajabule. UNtsako uthi: "Le nyama ayidingi ukuhlafuna kakhulu. Ithamba njengesinkwa!"

Ekugcineni uSkhumbuzo ubanika ubhanana nokhilimu. Usika ubhanana, athele ukhilimu phezu kwawo. Abangane bathi: "Siyabonga ngokusiphekela. Ngonyaka ozayo sizokuphekela thina." USkhumbuzo uyageza ibhodwe likagogo wakhe, alibuyisele ekhabetheni.

Imibuzo:
USkhumbuzo ufuna ukuphekela obani?
Ufuna ukuphekela abangane bakhe basemsebenzini.
Uyithola kuphi imbuya?
Uyithola kumakhelwane wakhe.
Ibhodwe likagogo wakhe lalikuphi?
Lalisekhabetheni.
Kungani amanzi ebhodweni echichima?
Ngoba uSkhumbuzo wakhuluma ocingweni isikhathi eside.
Abangane bayihlafuna kanjani inyama?
Bayihlafuna kancane, ngoba ithambile kakhulu.
Ekugcineni abangane badlani?
Badla ubhanana nokhilimu.

lessons.title: Izinyanga zikamkhulu
lessons.summary: At Kwambonambi grandfather Velile names the months the Zulu way: in December the rain comes and he and his grandson Sipheshile plant maize with manure and cover the holes; in March a flood ruins the field near the river, and in June they harvest what is left and he writes the Zulu month names on the calendar.
lessons.text:
USipheshile ungumfana wesikole waseThekwini. Ngamaholide kaZibandlela uya kumkhulu wakhe, uVelile, eKwambonambi. Umkhulu ulima ummbila nobhontshisi ensimini enkulu eduze nomfula.

Ekhishini likamkhulu kukhona ikhalenda odongeni. Kodwa umkhulu akalisebenzisi kakhulu ikhalenda. Ubiza izinyanga ngamagama esiZulu amadala. Uthi: "Wena uthi le nyanga nguDisemba. Mina ngithi nguZibandlela. UZibandlela uyinyanga yokutshala, ngoba ngalesi sikhathi kuqala ukuna."

Ngolunye usuku imvula yokuqala iyana. Ukuna kuthatha amahora amabili. Qede imvula iyeke, umkhulu uthatha ibhakede lomquba. Uthi: "Woza, Sipheshile. Inhlabathi imanzi manje. Yisikhathi sokutshala."

Ensimini bamba izimbobo eziningi. Umquba usebhakedeni. Lo mquba uvela esibayeni sezinkomo, futhi womile. Ufaka umquba omncane embotsheni ngayinye. Uthi: "Umquba wondla inhlabathi, futhi ummbila uyakhula kahle." USipheshile ubeka imbewu embotsheni ngayinye, bese egqiba imbobo ngenhlabathi. Basebenza usuku lonke. Ekupheleni kosuku bagqibe zonke izimbobo. Qede bafike ekhaya, bageza izandla, badle.

Ngemuva kwamaholide uSipheshile ubuyela eThekwini. Umkhulu umshayela ucingo njalo ngeSonto. Uyamtshela ukuthi ummbila ukhula kanjani. Ngemuva kwenyanga ummbila ufika emadolweni. NgoNdasa umkhulu uthi: "Kwenzeke into embi. Kwana kakhulu izinsuku ezine. Uzamcolo omkhulu wehla ngomfula. Uzamcolo wabhuqa ummbila oseduze nomfula."

USipheshile uyadabuka. Ucabanga ngomsebenzi wabo omkhulu. Uthi: "Konke kubhuqekile na?" Umkhulu uthi: "Cha. Uzamcolo ubhuqe ingxenye eseduze nomfula kuphela. Ummbila oseduze nentaba usaphila."

NgoNhlangulana uSipheshile ubuyela eKwambonambi ngamaholide asebusika. Umkhulu umbonisa ikhalenda. Kulo nyaka umkhulu ubhale amagama esiZulu ekhalendeni ngesandla sakhe: uZibandlela, uNdasa, uNhlangulana.

Ensimini ummbila womile. Umkhulu noSipheshile bavuna ummbila. Ummbila mncane kunowonyaka odlule, kodwa muhle. Umkhulu uthi: "Uzamcolo awubhuqanga konke. Umquba wenza inhlabathi yethu yaqina." USipheshile uthi: "Ngonyaka ozayo ngizobuya ngoZibandlela, sitshale futhi."

Imibuzo:
Kungani umkhulu ethi uZibandlela uyinyanga yokutshala?
Ngoba ngoZibandlela kuqala ukuna.
Umkhulu ufakani embotsheni ngayinye?
Ufaka umquba omncane.
USipheshile wenzani ngemuva kokubeka imbewu?
Ugqiba imbobo ngenhlabathi.
Kwenzekani ngoNdasa?
Uzamcolo omkhulu wabhuqa ummbila oseduze nomfula.
USipheshile ubuyela nini eKwambonambi?
Ubuyela ngoNhlangulana, ngamaholide asebusika.

lessons.title: Indlwana kaMfanufikile
lessons.summary: Following custom, eighteen-year-old Mfanufikile of Mtwalume rebuilds his late grandfather's small hut with his friend Gumede: they strip the old thatch, cockroaches scatter, they burn the rubbish and replace loose poles; without gloves he hurts his hand, falls and sprains his ankle, and a nurse gives him an injection.
lessons.text:
UMfanufikile uneminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalombili. Uhlala nabazali bakhe emzini wabo eMtwalume. Ngokwesiko lesiZulu, insizwa endala ihlala endlwaneni yayo emzini kayise. Ngakho uMfanufikile ufuna ukwakha indlwana yakhe.

Emzini kukhona indlwana endala kamkhulu wakhe ongasekho. Ubaba uthi: "Ungayisebenzisa leyo ndlwana. Kodwa kufanele uqale uyiqaqe, ngoba indala kakhulu." Umngane kaMfanufikile, uGumede, uthi uzomncedisa.

NgoMgqibelo ekuseni basebenza ndawonye. Okokuqala baqaqa uphahla oludala lotshani. Uma baqaqa utshani, amaphela amaningi aphuma agijime yonke indawo. UGumede uyahleka, athi: "Amaphela athanda izindlu ezindala!" Phansi kukhona izibi eziningi: amaphepha amadala, izingubo ezidabukile namabhodlela. Baqoqa izibi zonke, bazishise ngaphandle.

Bese bebheka izigxobo. Isigxobo esisodwa siyaxega, futhi esinye siyabola. UGumede uthi: "Lezi zigxobo ezimbili kufanele sizikhiphe." Baqaqa izigxobo ezindala, bafake izigxobo ezintsha.

UMfanufikile uthatha isando, aqinise amapulangwe esigxotsheni. Akagqokile amagilavu. Isando sishaya iminwe yakhe kanye, kodwa uyaqhubeka. Bese insimbi endala egqwalile imsika esandleni. Igazi liyaphuma. UGumede uthi: "Hlanza isandla sakho ngamanzi." UMfanufikile usigeza, aqhubeke nomsebenzi.

Ngemuva kwalokho uMfanufikile ukhwela phezu kwendlwana ukuze alungise uphahla. Lapho ehla, uyawa phansi. Iqakala lakhe livuvukala ngokushesha, futhi libuhlungu kakhulu. UGumede uyamncedisa ukuhamba. Bahamba ndawonye baya esibhedlela.

Esibhedlela unesi ubheka iqakala. Uthi: "Iqakala alaphukanga. Libuhlungu nje. Phumula izinsuku ezimbalwa." Bese unesi ubona isandla. Uthi: "Wasikwa yinsimbi egqwalile? Kufanele ngikujove." Unesi uyamjova engalweni. UMfanufikile akathandi ukujovwa, kodwa uyathula.

Ngemuva kwesonto iqakala liphilile. UMfanufikile noGumede baqeda indlwana. Manje uMfanufikile ugqoka amagilavu ngaso sonke isikhathi lapho esebenzisa isando. Ubaba uyibuka indlwana, athi: "Umkhulu wakho ubezojabula."

Imibuzo:
Kungani uMfanufikile efuna ukwakha indlwana?
Ngoba ngokwesiko lesiZulu insizwa endala ihlala endlwaneni yayo.
Kwenzekani lapho beqaqa uphahla oludala?
Amaphela amaningi aphuma, futhi phansi bathola izibi eziningi.
Kungani uMfanufikile esikeka esandleni?
Ngoba wayengagqokile amagilavu, futhi insimbi egqwalile yamsika.
Unesi wenzani esibhedlela?
Ubheka iqakala, bese ejova uMfanufikile engalweni.
Manje uMfanufikile ugqokani uma esebenzisa isando?
Ugqoka amagilavu.

lessons.title: Usuku lukaNtombikhona
lessons.summary: For Ntombikhona's coming-of-age celebration in Ezakheni she irons the family's clothes, bathes in the cold river at dawn instead of the shower, the men roast the ribs of the slaughtered cow, her father turns away her uncle's bottle of spirits, she keeps dancing when she wants to give up, and her grandmother gives her silver earrings.
lessons.text:
UNtombikhona waseZakheni uneminyaka engamashumi amabili. Ubaba wakhe uthi: "Uyintombi enhle, futhi uhlonipha abazali bakho. NgoMgqibelo sizokwenzela umemulo." Umemulo usho ukuthi intombazane isikhulile, futhi umndeni wayo uyabonga.

NgoLwesihlanu ebusuku uNtombikhona uyayina izingubo zakhe nezikamama wakhe. Uyayina indwangu ebomvu nengubo emhlophe kamama. Uyayina kahle kakhulu, ngoba abantu abaningi bazofika.

NgoMgqibelo ekuseni kakhulu, ngaphambi kokuthi ilanga liphume, uNtombikhona nabangane bakhe abathathu baya emfuleni. Ngokwesiko intombazane ihlamba emfuleni ngosuku lwayo. Amanzi ayabanda kakhulu. Omunye umngane wakhe uthi: "Ekhaya sinayo ishawa enamanzi ashisayo!" UNtombikhona uyahleka. Uthi: "Ishawa ingeyezinsuku zonke. Namuhla ngihlamba emfuleni." Bonke bahlamba ndawonye, babuyele ekhaya behuba.

Ekhaya amadoda ahlaba inkomo. Abesifazane bapheka inyama emabhodweni amakhulu. Abanye abantu bosa izimbambo zenkomo emlilweni. Ubambo ngalunye lukhulu futhi lunamafutha. Izingane zithanda izimbambo kakhulu. Umama kaNtombikhona umnika ubambo olukhulu, ngoba lolu wusuku lwakhe.

Emini kufika umalume kaNtombikhona. Ufika nebhodlela likagologo ekhukhwini lejazi lakhe. Ubaba uthi: "Namuhla asiphuzi ugologo. Siphuza utshwala besiZulu kuphela." Umalume uyahleka, abeke ugologo emotweni yakhe.

UNtombikhona usina nezintombi isikhathi eside ngaphambi kwabantu. Uyakhathala, futhi ufuna ukuduba. Unina uthi: "Ungadubi, ntombi yami! Lolu wusuku lwakho!" Ngakho uNtombikhona uyaqhubeka nokusina.

Kusihlwa ubaba ukhipha iphepha ekhukhwini lakhe. Ufunda amazwi amahle ngendodakazi yakhe ngaphambi kwabantu. UNtombikhona uyakhala, futhi izinyembezi zehla ezihlathini zakhe.

Ekugcineni ugogo wakhe usondela kuye. Umnika amacici amadala esiliva. Uthi: "Lawa macici ayengawami ngesikhathi ngineminyaka yakho. Manje angawakho." Ugogo umqabula esihlathini. UNtombikhona ugqoka amacici, futhi uyajabula kakhulu.

Imibuzo:
UNtombikhona wenzani ngoLwesihlanu ebusuku?
Wayina izingubo zakhe nezikamama wakhe.
Kungani uNtombikhona engahlambi eshaweni ngoMgqibelo ekuseni?
Ngoba ngokwesiko intombazane ihlamba emfuleni ngosuku lwayo.
Umalume ufika nebhodlela likagologo na?
Yebo, ufika nebhodlela likagologo ekhukhwini lejazi lakhe.
Kwenzekani lapho uNtombikhona efuna ukuduba?
Unina wathi angadubi, ngakho waqhubeka nokusina.
Ugogo wanikani uNtombikhona?
Wamnika amacici amadala, futhi wamqabula esihlathini.

lessons.title: Isicebi nompofu
lessons.summary: Long ago a rich man, Mavuso, refuses to pay for the maize his cattle ate, and hostility grows; he buys guns and lead to take poor Mngadi's land by force, ignores the chief's warning, and when his men attack, Mngadi's family takes refuge with the chief, whose men drive them back; the chief judges the case and Mavuso pays ten cattle.
lessons.text:
Kudala, ngesikhathi samakhosi, kwakuhlala amadoda amabili esigodini esisodwa. UMavuso wayeyisicebi. Wayenezinkomo eziningi kakhulu nemizi emithathu. UMngadi wayengumuntu ompofu. Wayenensimu encane nezinkomo ezimbili kuphela.

Ngolunye unyaka izinkomo zikaMavuso zangena ensimini kaMngadi, zadla ummbila wakhe wonke. UMngadi waya kuMavuso wathi: "Izinkomo zakho zidle ukudla kwezingane zami." UMavuso wahleka. Wathi: "Mina ngiyisicebi, wena umpofu. Isicebi asikhokheli abampofu." Kusukela ngalolo suku kwaba nobutha obukhulu phakathi kwemindeni yomibili.

Iminyaka emibili kwakunobutha phakathi kwabo. UMavuso wayefuna umhlaba kaMngadi, ngoba wawuseduze nomfula. Wathi: "Uma engafuni ukuwunikela, ngizowuthatha ngempoqo." Wathenga izibhamu kubahwebi abamhlophe, nomthofu wokwenza izinhlamvu. Wahlomisa izinsizwa zakhe ngezibhamu.

Inkosi yezwe lelo yezwa ngalokho. Yathumela induna yayo kuMavuso nesixwayiso. Induna yathi: "Inkosi ithi: Ungalwi nomakhelwane wakho. Lesi yisixwayiso sokugcina." Kodwa uMavuso akasilalelanga isixwayiso. Wayezethemba ngoba wayeyisicebi.

Ngobunye ubusuku izinsizwa zikaMavuso zahamba ziya emzini kaMngadi zinezibhamu. UMngadi wezwa umsindo wazo. Yena nomfazi wakhe nezingane zabo babaleka ebumnyameni. Baphephela emzini wenkosi. Inkosi yabamukela, yathi: "Lapha niphephile."

Bese inkosi ilayela induna yayo. Ithi: "Thatha amadoda angamashumi amabili. Dudula izinsizwa zikaMavuso, kodwa ungabulali muntu." Induna yenza njengoba inkosi iyilayele. Amadoda enkosi agijima aya emzini kaMngadi. Adudula izinsizwa zikaMavuso aze azikhiphe esigodini. Izinsizwa zabaleka, zashiya izibhamu zazo phansi.

Ngakusasa inkosi yabiza uMavuso noMngadi enkundleni. Yalalela bobabili. Yathi: "Angehluleli umuntu ngemali yakhe noma ngobumpofu bakhe. Ngehlulela ngalokho akwenzile." Ekugcineni inkosi yagweba. Yathi uMavuso kufanele anike uMngadi izinkomo eziyishumi. Izibhamu nomthofu kaMavuso zaba ngezenkosi.

UMavuso wakhokha izinkomo. Kancane kancane ubutha bwaphela. Kwathi ngemuva kweminyaka, indodana kaMavuso yashada nendodakazi kaMngadi.

Imibuzo:
Yini eyaqala ubutha phakathi kukaMavuso noMngadi?
Izinkomo zikaMavuso zadla ummbila kaMngadi, futhi uMavuso akakhokhanga.
UMavuso wahlomisa izinsizwa zakhe ngani?
Wazihlomisa ngezibhamu, futhi wathenga nomthofu wokwenza izinhlamvu.
Kungani uMavuso engasilalelanga isixwayiso senkosi?
Ngoba wayezethemba, ngoba wayeyisicebi.
UMngadi nomndeni wakhe baphephela kuphi?
Baphephela emzini wenkosi.
UMavuso wayefuna ukuthatha umhlaba kaMngadi kanjani?
Wayefuna ukuwuthatha ngempoqo, ngezibhamu.
Inkosi yagweba ukuthi kwenziwani?
Yagweba ukuthi uMavuso anike uMngadi izinkomo eziyishumi.

lessons.title: Ifilimu ebhayisikobho
lessons.summary: Ndalo, who is going out with Nomaphelo in Pietermaritzburg, respectfully knocks at her father's door before taking her to the cinema; a neighbour gossips that it is a disgrace, the tickets are sold out and they are disappointed, Nomaphelo is hurt by the gossip, the neighbour apologises, and the next week they see the film.
lessons.text:
UNdalo noNomaphelo bajola izinyanga ezintathu. Bobabili bahlala eMgungundlovu. NgoLwesihlanu ebusuku uNdalo ufuna ukuthatha uNomaphelo baye ebhayisikobho. Ebhayisikobho kukhona ifilimu emnandi ngamaZulu akudala nangamakhosi awo.

Ngokwesiko, insizwa ehloniphayo ihlonipha umndeni wentombi. Ngakho uNdalo akambizi uNomaphelo ngaphandle komuzi. Uya emzini wabo, angqongqoze emnyango. Ungqongqoza kathathu. Ubaba kaNomaphelo uvula umnyango.

UNdalo uthi: "Sawubona, baba. Ngicela ukuhamba noNomaphelo siye ebhayisikobho." Ubaba umbuka isikhathi eside. Bese uthi: "Kulungile. Ngiyakwazi ukuthi uyajola nendodakazi yami. Ngiyabonga ngokuthi ungqongqoze emnyango wami. Konje, ngifuna abuye ekhaya ngehora leshumi."

Owesifazane omdala ohlala eduze ubabona behamba ndawonye emgwaqweni. Ngakusasa uhleba nabanye abesifazane esitolo. Uthi: "Nibonile? UNomaphelo ujola nensizwa! Bahamba bodwa ebusuku. Lawa ngamanyala!" Abesifazane bayahleba, futhi indaba ihamba ngokushesha.

Ebhayisikobho kunabantu abaningi kakhulu. Amathikithi aphelile. Abakwazi ukubona ifilimu. Lokhu kuyabajabhisa kakhulu, ngoba bebeyifuna kakhulu le filimu. Ngakho bahamba emgwaqweni, badle ukudla okuncane, baxoxe. UNomaphelo ubuyela ekhaya ngehora leshumi, njengoba ubaba wakhe ethe.

NgoMgqibelo uNomaphelo uzwa ukuthi owesifazane omdala ubemhleba esitolo. Uyadana kakhulu. Uthi kumama wakhe: "Mama, akukho manyala engiwenzile. Kungani abantu bengihleba?"

Umama uthi: "Ungadani, ntombi yami. Ubaba wakho uyamazi uNdalo. UNdalo wangqongqoza emnyango, wacela kubaba wakho. Lokho kukhombisa ukuthi uyasihlonipha." Bese umama uya kowesifazane omdala, akhulume naye.

Owesifazane omdala uza emzini kaNomaphelo. Uthi: "Ngiyaxolisa, ntombi yami. Bengihleba ngingazi lutho. Ngiyabona ukuthi akukho manyala. Ngiyajabha." UNomaphelo uthi: "Kulungile, gogo."

NgoLwesihlanu olulandelayo uNdalo uthenga amathikithi ekuseni. Kusihlwa uNdalo noNomaphelo babona ifilimu ebhayisikobho. Ifilimu ayibajabhisi. Inhle kakhulu.

Imibuzo:
UNdalo wenzani lapho efika emzini kaNomaphelo?
Wangqongqoza emnyango, wacela kubaba kaNomaphelo.
Ubaba kaNomaphelo wathini ngehora?
Wathi, konje, ufuna abuye ekhaya ngehora leshumi.
Owesifazane omdala wenzani esitolo?
Wahleba ngoNomaphelo, wathi ujola nensizwa futhi lawo ngamanyala.
Kungani uNdalo noNomaphelo bajabha ngoLwesihlanu wokuqala?
Ngoba amathikithi ebhayisikobho ayephelile.
Kungani uNomaphelo edana ngoMgqibelo?
Ngoba wezwa ukuthi owesifazane omdala ubemhleba.
